title: Report Page Blueprint
eyebrow: Built — and this page is the first one made by the tool

actions.fyi: Nothing is waiting on you. The tools are in place and this page was made by them. Override any decision below if you disagree with one.

status.now: Everything you asked for is built, and this page proves it by being the first one built.
status.next_up: Nothing is queued. The next real result becomes the first working report made this way.

The word list grows each time a term slips through

content.label: How this sticks
content.lead: Agents no longer write a page. They fill one, and the tool draws it.

blocks.label: Teeth
blocks.text: Each of those rules has a test that goes red when the rule is switched off — twenty-four of them, run with the rest of the suite.

content.label: The shape
content.lead: Six slots, always in this order, none of them optional.

rows.title: Title
rows.note: A short name, six words or fewer

rows.title: What I need from you
rows.note: The questions themselves, answered by clicking — never a pointer to a number further down

rows.title: Where we are
rows.note: One now line, the very next piece of work, then done and remaining

rows.title: Content
rows.note: One card per section. How to show it is the agent's choice

rows.title: Decisions
rows.note: Every call already made, each with a button to flag it for change

rows.title: Next
rows.note: What happens if you say nothing, then the steps with a cost each

content.label: On the shelf
content.lead: Twelve ways to show a result, shared by every report.

rows: Before and after
Two pictures side by side, both opening full screen together
Wipe
One frame, dragged between the two versions
Pictures
One or many, click to enlarge, scroll to zoom, drag to pan
Table
Coloured columns, one look everywhere
Big number
The single figure that is the result
Bars
Before against after on one measure
Trend
A measure over time or over settings
Breakdown
Where the time goes, in one bar
Note
A warning, a caveat, a headline finding
Rows
A short ordered list with a note on each
List
Plain points
Sentence
One line — a paragraph is refused

blocks.label: Growing it
blocks.text: A graphic nobody has built yet gets added to the shelf, so every later report has it too — never drawn into one page.

decisions.title: The last-thing-I-did box is cut
decisions.why: Your call. It repeated the last ticked item; a single now line replaced it.

decisions.title: The action slot holds real questions, never decision numbers
decisions.why: You should never hunt for what is being asked.

decisions.title: A decision reaches the action slot only if your input is required
decisions.why: Everything else is decided and listed here.

decisions.title: Decision numbers never change
decisions.why: The page updates in place, so a number you answered last week still means the same thing.

decisions.title: Next always states the do-nothing outcome and a cost per item
How to show a result is the agent's choice
decisions.why: Table, chart, note, picture — whatever fits. The tool fixes the frame and the look, never the form of the content.

decisions.title: The shape ships as a tool, not a written description
Plain words are enforced by a gate, not by a rule
decisions.why: The rule existed all along and builder-speak still arrived.

decisions.title: One running page per piece of work
decisions.why: Same link, updated in place. A new link means new work.

decisions.title: The look lives in one place agents cannot write
decisions.why: It fixes the colours, the sizes and the spacing — not a catalogue of graphics.

decisions.title: New graphics are added to the shared shelf, never to one page
decisions.why: The shelf grows; the look never forks.

decisions.title: A new graphic is free, a new colour or typeface is not
decisions.why: Widening the palette is a question for you, asked once rather than per page.

decisions.title: Every report answers itself
decisions.why: Contents rail, answer buttons, override buttons, and one press that copies your reply ready to paste. A page cannot type into the session on its own — this is as close as the platform allows.

decisions.title: Every picture opens full screen and zooms
decisions.why: Results are judged by looking closely. A pair moves together so the same detail stays side by side.

decisions.title: Nothing counts as done until it holds without me
decisions.why: Work drawn once by hand shows amber, never ticked. Green means an agent who never saw this conversation gets it automatically.

decisions.title: Builder-speak is named, not blocked
decisions.why: Your call. Every term is listed with what to say instead, and the count comes back with the link — but an unfamiliar word never costs you a report.

next.if_nothing: Nothing to decide — the next result simply arrives as a page built this way.

steps.step: Use it on the next real result
Add each term that slips through to the word list
Add a graphic to the shelf the first time a result needs one
